clientId.description: Identifies different clients within a consumer. Unless you want to loadbalance, send the same clientId in every API request. If you do wish to use multiple clients to loadbalance, each client should send a different clientId. Updates will be loadbalanced between the active clientIds.

version.description: Version of the Updates that will be received.

maxSize.description: Limits the amount of updates received in each update batch.

maxTimeout.description: Limits how long the api request will wait for new updates before returning the request in milliseconds. A value of 50000 is recommended, but make sure your infrastructure can handle the selected timeout value.

pathFilters.description: Paths of a visit (starting with /) this tracker cares about, e.g. ['/importDeclarations', '/visitDeclaration']. If something changes outside of these paths the tracker will not get the update. Note that the tracker will still always get the entire visit returned (not just the selected paths).

items.description: Paths of a visit (starting with /) this tracker cares about, e.g. ['/importDeclarations', '/visitDeclaration']. If something changes outside of these paths the tracker will not get the update. Note that the tracker will still always get the entire visit returned (not just the selected paths).

consignmentTypes.description: The type of cargo data you want to track. Can be 'import' and 'export', when not configured the default is 'import' only

items.description: The type of cargo data you want to track. Can be 'import' and 'export', when not configured the default is 'import' only
